items.headline: The Pruneyard Master Use Permit moves to approved
items.summary: The Pruneyard Master Use Permit in Campbell has moved from Under Construction to Approved. The retail project is 27-acre shopping and office center.

items.headline: City weighs possible legal action against fire truck makers
items.summary: The City Council met in closed session to discuss potential litigation involving fire apparatus manufacturers Golden State Fire Apparatus, Pierce Manufacturing, Oshkosh Corporation, REV Group, Rosenbauer America, and the Fire Apparatus Manufacturers' Association.

items.headline: TIAA approved for three wall signs on El Camino Real
items.summary: The City approved architectural review for three illuminated wall signs reading 'TIAA' at 2875 El Camino Real, pointing to a new tenant at that address.

items.headline: Massage Envy cleared for new LED signage at 2515 El Camino Real
items.summary: Two new LED channel-letter wall signs for Massage Envy were approved at 2515 El Camino Real, indicating the business is moving into the location.

items.headline: Council held study session on Highway 17 congestion relief
items.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council held a study session on the State Route 17 Corridor Congestion Relief Project, addressing traffic congestion on the highway that connects Los Gatos to Santa Cruz.
